description: The design has no signed payload or authentication; a customer id header is not proof of origin.
Retries have no cap or dead-letter path, so a poison endpoint can block delivery forever.
There is no consumer idempotency or delivery deduplication, so retries can duplicate side effects.
There is no per-customer rate limit or backpressure; one slow or high-volume customer can starve the queue.
